actionsboardDuo.description: An extension for keeping track of your CI. It shows CI build status as a tree (account = server → workflow/plan → run/build → job), with a summary in the status bar. Tokens are kept only in SecretStorage; polling is read-only, with no tracking.
config.accounts: CI accounts (servers). Each entry is { id, name, baseUrl, kind? } — kind is "github" (the default when omitted) or "bamboo"; for Bamboo, baseUrl is the server's base URL. Personal access tokens are NOT stored here; they live in SecretStorage and are entered from the settings form.
config.groups: Groups: named bundles of watched workflows / plans. Each group is { id, name, accountId, workflows: [...] }; entries are { owner, repo, workflow, starred? } under a GitHub account and { projectKey, planKey, starred? } under a Bamboo account.
config.livenessInterval: Server liveness check interval in seconds. Runs on its own cycle, separate from build polling; one light request per account per cycle.
config.notificationScope: Which build failures to notify about.
config.notifyFailure: Notify when a watched workflow's newest run fails.
config.notifyAuthError: Notify when a CI server reports an authentication error (a token problem).
config.notifyOutage: Notify when a CI server becomes unreachable.
config.notifyRecovery: Notify when an unreachable CI server recovers.
config.pollHidden: Build polling interval in seconds while the CI Board view is hidden.
config.pollVisible: Build polling interval in seconds while the CI Board view is visible.
